comment: Expected output of Rust src/memory::extract_links (and its Python mirror in scripts/tests/test_migrate_memory_split.py) over the See Also section of link_parser_samples.md. `target` is the raw stem exactly as Rust LinkRef.target reports it — layer prefixes (agent:/user:) are NOT stripped. Dropped sample classes (external/anchor/mailto/bare-name/empty/outside-section) appear here only by their absence. Keep in sync with both parsers; if a parser change breaks this file, update it deliberately.
